edges.reason: Constructor sets owner from the untrusted caller address msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender with owner before allowing ownership staging.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender to equal the staged newOwner.
transfer debits and credits balances using msg.sender as the source account.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender to locate and decrement the spender allowance.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the callee.
transferAnyERC20Token is restricted by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender.
transfer delegates its subtraction to safeSub.
transfer delegates its addition to safeAdd.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transferFrom uses safeSub for both balance and allowance decrements.
transferFrom uses safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom mutates balances[from] and balances[to].
transferFrom mutates allowed[from][msg.sender].
approve writes the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall invokes an untrusted spender contract through receiveApproval.
The external callback can re-enter the contract and observe or manipulate the already-written allowed state.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into a caller-supplied token contract.
The swept foreign tokens are sent to the owner address.
safeAdd performs the raw addition a + b that depends on the require(c >= a) overflow check.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
transferOwnership writes newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads and clears newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
Token constructor initializes _totalSupply.
Token constructor allocates the whole supply into balances.
Token constructor sets symbol.
Token constructor sets name.
Token constructor sets decimals.
transfer recipient parameter flows into the balances credit.
transfer amount parameter flows into safeSub/safeAdd.
transferFrom source parameter indexes balances and allowed.
transferFrom destination parameter indexes balances.
transferFrom amount parameter flows into safeSub/safeAdd.
approve spender parameter indexes the allowed mapping.
approve amount parameter is stored as the allowance.
approveAndCall spender parameter becomes allowance key and external call target.
approveAndCall amount parameter is stored and forwarded.
approveAndCall data parameter is forwarded verbatim to the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress parameter becomes the target of the external ERC20 transfer call.
tokens parameter is the amount passed to the external transfer call.
_newOwner parameter is written to the newOwner state variable.
safeSub minuend parameter a is used in the subtraction.
safeSub subtrahend parameter b is used in the subtraction and require.
safeSub local result c receives the subtraction output.
balanceOf named return variable carries balances[tokenOwner].
allowance named return variable carries allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
